`create_model` determines whether flat snapshots are requested, but never converts `sns` itself: it still passes the original MultiIndex to the variable and constraint builders, including the loss builders. Only the model parameter is explicitly converted via `_snapshots_parameter`; the context manager changes component-data access, not the `sns` arguments. Thus the required representation is not used consistently when `"flat"` is selected or `"auto"` resolves to flat.
